shortDescription: Set Serial port parameters in WTI OOB and PDU devices

options.name: break_allow
options.description: This is if the break character is allowed to be passed through the port, 0=Off, 1=On

options.name: cmd
options.description: This is the Admin Mode to assign to the port, 0=Deny, 1=Permit.

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: echo
options.description: -This is the command echo parameter to assign to the port, 0=Off, 1=On

options.name: handshake
options.description: This is the handshake to assign to the port, 0=None, 1=XON/XOFF, 2=RTS/CTS, 3=Both.

options.name: logoff
options.description: This is the logout character to assign to the port If preceded by a ^ character, the sequence will be a control character. Used if seq is set to 0 or 1

options.name: mode
options.description: This is the port mode to assign to the port, 0=Any-to-Any. 1=Passive, 2=Buffer, 3=Modem, 4=ModemPPP.

options.name: parity
options.description: This is the parity to assign to the port, 0=7-None, 1=7-Even, 2=7-Odd, 3=8-None, 4=8-Even, 5=8-Odd.

options.name: port
options.description: This is the port number that is getting the action performed on.

options.name: portname
options.description: This is the Name of the Port that is displayed.

options.name: seq
options.description: This is the type of Sequence Disconnect to assign to the port, 1=Three Characters (before and after), 2=One Character Only, 3=Off

options.name: stopbits
options.description: This is the stop bits to assign to the port, 1=1 Stop Bit, 2=2 Stop Bit.

options.name: tout
options.description: This is the Port Activity Timeout to assign to the port, 0=Off, 1=5 Min, 2=15 Min, 3=30 Min, 4=90 Min, 5=1 Min.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
